  "title": "Sales and Marketing Officer",
  "description": "HRsmartrecruit - Our client, Greengates Specialties Limited, is recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Sales and Marketing Officer

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Business Development Manager (BDM)

?About the Role


	?We are looking for a driven, people-focused Sales and Marketing Officer to join our growth team at Greengates Specialties Limited.
	In this role, you&rsquo;ll be on the front lines of our B2B operations - connecting with industrial clients across food, beverage, cosmetics, and manufacturing sectors.
	?You&rsquo;ll work closely with our Business Development Manager (BDM), and production teams to build real relationships with plant managers and procurement heads, share our product line, and help us expand our market footprint.


?What You&rsquo;ll Do


	Find, reach out to, and build relationships with new industrial manufacturing clients, managing the process from first contact to closing the deal.
	Act as the trusted point of contact for procurement officers and plant managers, listening to their feedback and making sure their raw material needs are met on time.
	Work side-by-side with our BDM, R&amp;D lab, and marketing teams to shape sales campaigns that fit local market demands.
	Gather practical market intelligence - tracking industry trends, watching competitor moves, and finding fresh opportunities for product innovation.
	Create and present clear, engaging product samples and presentations that show potential clients exactly how our ingredients add value to their production.
	Keep your sales pipeline organized in our CRM and share regular updates with management so everyone stays aligned.


?What We&rsquo;re Looking For


	HND, BSc, or Advanced Diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Food Science, Chemistry, or a related field.
	3 to 6 years in a B2B sales or marketing role, ideally selling raw materials, food ingredients, specialty chemicals, or FMCG products.
	A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and growing a territory.
	Comfortable speaking to different audiences - from factory floors to executive boardrooms and turning technical product details into simple benefits.
	Natural interpersonal skills, strong negotiation ability, and a genuine openness to constructive feedback.
	?Skilled at spotting market shifts, understanding what industrial buyers need, and turning trends into new sales opportunities.
	Comfortable collaborating across departments, especially with technical QA and logistics teams.
	Fluency in English is required; being able to speak additional Nigerian languages (like Hausa or Yoruba) is a huge plus for connecting with regional clients.
	Good command of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and basic experience with CRM software.
	Willingness to travel locally and regionally to visit factories, production plants, and client offices.


?What We Offer


	?We believe in taking good care of the people who help us grow. When you join Greengates Specialties, you can expect:
	
		A solid base Salary: N150,000 - N250,000 / month paired with performance incentives that reward your hard work and closed deals.
		Paid annual leave every year.
		Comprehensive medical coverage to ensure you and your well-being are always looked after.
		Full pension compliance to support your long-term financial security.
		Hands-on experience in the fast-growing specialty ingredient industry, working directly alongside senior industry leaders and technical experts.
	
	


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: jobgsl321@gmail.com cc: patience.onu@greengates-specialties.com using &quot;Sales and Marketing Officer&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Sales and Marketing Officer Job at HRsmartrecruit




        
    

        
        HRsmartrecruit - Our client, Greengates Specialties Limited, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales and Marketing Officer

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Business Development Manager (BDM)

?About the Role
     

            
    




	?We are looking for a driven, people-focused Sales and Marketing Officer to join our growth team at Greengates Specialties Limited.
	In this role, you’ll be on the front lines of our B2B operations - connecting with industrial clients across food, beverage, cosmetics, and manufacturing sectors.
	?You’ll work closely with our Business Development Manager (BDM), and production teams to build real relationships with plant managers and procurement heads, share our product line, and help us expand our market footprint.


?What You’ll Do


	Find, reach out to, and build relationships with new industrial manufacturing clients, managing the process from first contact to closing the deal.
	Act as the trusted point of contact for procurement officers and plant managers, listening to their feedback and making sure their raw material needs are met on time.
	Work side-by-side with our BDM, R&D lab, and marketing teams to shape sales campaigns that fit local market demands.
	Gather practical market intelligence - tracking industry trends, watching competitor moves, and finding fresh opportunities for product innovation.
	Create and present clear, engaging product samples and presentations that show potential clients exactly how our ingredients add value to their production.
	Keep your sales pipeline organized in our CRM and share regular updates with management so everyone stays aligned.


?What We’re Looking For


	HND, BSc, or Advanced Diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Food Science, Chemistry, or a related field.
	3 to 6 years in a B2B sales or marketing role, ideally selling raw materials, food ingredients, specialty chemicals, or FMCG products.
	A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and growing a territory.
	Comfortable speaking to different audiences - from factory floors to executive boardrooms and turning technical product details into simple benefits.
	Natural interpersonal skills, strong negotiation ability, and a genuine openness to constructive feedback.
	?Skilled at spotting market shifts, understanding what industrial buyers need, and turning trends into new sales opportunities.
	Comfortable collaborating across departments, especially with technical QA and logistics teams.
	Fluency in English is required; being able to speak additional Nigerian languages (like Hausa or Yoruba) is a huge plus for connecting with regional clients.
	Good command of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and basic experience with CRM software.
	Willingness to travel locally and regionally to visit factories, production plants, and client offices.


?What We Offer


	?We believe in taking good care of the people who help us grow. When you join Greengates Specialties, you can expect:
	
		A solid base Salary: N150,000 - N250,000 / month paired with performance incentives that reward your hard work and closed deals.
		Paid annual leave every year.
		Comprehensive medical coverage to ensure you and your well-being are always looked after.
		Full pension compliance to support your long-term financial security.
		Hands-on experience in the fast-growing specialty ingredient industry, working directly alongside senior industry leaders and technical experts.
	
	


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] cc: [email protected] using "Sales and Marketing Officer" as the subject of the email.

Call Verification Officer (Hausa) Job at PalmPay Limited




        
    

        
        PalmPay is an Africa-focused fintech firm, launched in 2019. PalmPay is a mobile payments platform that offers a number of financial services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Call Verification Officer (Hausa)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Job Summary


	The Call Verification Officer will be responsible for conducting outbound verification calls to customers, confirming information provided during onboarding and loan application processes, and ensuring compliance with internal verification standards.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Conduct outbound calls to verify customer information and documentation
	Perform prequalification checks based on defined criteria
	Accurately document call outcomes and customer responses
	Escalate discrepancies, inconsistencies, or red flags identified during calls


Requirements


	0-1 year of experience in Customer Service, Customer Relations, Call Centre Operations, Verification, or a related role.
	Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Must be able to speak Hausa, non-Hausa speaking candidates will not be considered.
	Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office and other computer applications.
	Candidates must reside within Ikeja or its immediate environs. This is a mandatory requirement.


Salary
N100,000 Monthly.

Job Position: HR / Admin Manager

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a hands-on and commercially minded Human Resources Manager to lead day-to-day HR operations, with strong ownership of performance management, employee engagement, talent development and HR processes.
	The ideal candidate is not simply an HR administrator but a people-performance professional who can translate business objectives into measurable employee expectations, track performance, address gaps and drive accountability across teams.


Key Responsibilities
Performance Management:


	Design, implement and continuously improve the company&#39;s performance management system.
	Develop clear KPIs, KRAs and performance targets in collaboration with department heads.
	Coordinate monthly, quarterly and annual performance reviews.
	Track individual and departmental performance against agreed targets.
	Identify performance gaps and work with managers to develop Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where necessary.
	Maintain performance records and provide management with actionable performance reports.
	Support managers in handling underperformance, goal-setting, feedback and employee accountability.
	Ensure performance outcomes inform promotions, rewards, training and other people decisions.


HR Operations:


	Manage the full employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit.
	Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation and personnel files.
	Ensure effective implementation of company policies, procedures and employee guidelines.
	Handle employee relations matters professionally and confidentially.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, leave and general workforce discipline.
	Support payroll preparation by providing accurate employee and attendance information.
	Ensure compliance with applicable Nigerian employment regulations and company policies.


Talent Acquisition &amp; Workforce Planning:


	Manage recruitment processes from job profiling and sourcing through interviews, selection and onboarding.
	Work with managers to identify manpower requirements and define suitable candidate profiles.
	Develop structured interview and assessment processes.
	Monitor recruitment effectiveness, employee retention and hiring quality.


Administration:


	Oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the organisation.
	Develop and maintain efficient administrative systems, procedures and workflows.
	Manage office facilities, supplies, equipment, utilities and general workplace requirements.
	Coordinate office vendors, service providers and maintenance activities.
	Monitor administrative expenses and support effective cost control.
	Ensure proper documentation, filing and retrieval of company records.
	Coordinate meetings, internal events, official correspondence and general office logistics.
	Establish and enforce administrative standards across departments.
	Ensure the workplace remains organised, functional, professional and conducive to productivity.
	Liaise with external service providers, government agencies and other relevant stakeholders where required.
	Identify administrative inefficiencies and implement practical solutions


Learning &amp; Development:


	Identify training needs through performance reviews, competency gaps and business requirements.
	Coordinate employee training, development and induction programmes.
	Track the effectiveness and business impact of training interventions.


Employee Engagement &amp; Culture:


	Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement, productivity and retention.
	Establish effective channels for employee feedback.
	Support management in resolving workplace concerns and maintaining a productive work environment.
	Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism and continuous improvement.


Success in This Role
Success will be measured by the HR Manager&#39;s ability to:


	Establish a clear and measurable performance culture.
	Improve employee accountability and productivity.
	Ensure performance reviews are timely and meaningful.
	Reduce recurring performance and employee-relations issues.
	Improve quality of hires and employee retention.
	Provide management with accurate, timely and actionable HR insights.
	Build HR processes that are structured, practical and consistently implemented.


What We Are Looking For


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Management or a related discipline.
	3&ndash;5 years of hands-on HR experience, preferably in a fast-paced or performance-driven organisation with at least 1 yearin supervisory capacity.
	Strong practical experience in Performance Management, KPI/KRA development and employee evaluation.
	Demonstrable experience managing employee performance issues and implementing PIPs.
	Strong knowledge of recruitment, employee relations, HR operations and HR documentation.
	Excellent knowledge of Google Workspace and HR productivity tools.
	Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to turn people data into useful management insights.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills.
	Strong understanding of Nigerian employment practices and workplace regulations.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM or equivalent is an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Performance Management
	HR Operations
	Employee Relations
	Recruitment
	KPI Development
	Talent Development
	HR Analytics
	Conflict Resolution
	Policy Implementation
	Workforce Planning.

HR Business Partner Job at Foteino Talento




        
    

        
        Foteino Talento, a workspace, content creation studio and HR consultancy company, is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Business Partner

Job Location: Lagos

Role Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a commercially minded and strategic HR Business Partner (HRBP) to partner with leadership and drive people strategies that support organisational growth and performance.
	The successful candidate will work closely with business leaders across workforce planning, organisational effectiveness, talent management, performance, employee engagement, culture, and people analytics.


Key Responsibilities


	Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into people strategies.
	Provide strategic HR advice on workforce and organisational decisions.
	Lead workforce planning, organisational design and talent initiatives.
	Strengthen performance management and employee development.
	Drive employee engagement, culture and retention initiatives.
	Develop HR metrics, dashboards and people insights to support decision-making.
	Support succession planning, leadership development and organisational growth.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Psychology or a related field.
	3–5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in an HRBP, HR Generalist, People & Culture or strategic HR role.
	Professional certification such as CIPM or SHRM is an advantage.
	Experience partnering with managers/business leaders on people-related decisions.
	Strong knowledge of performance management, talent management, workforce planning and employee engagement.
	Good understanding of Nigerian employment practices and HR legislation.
	Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; HRIS/people analytics experience is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected]using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
